title: Quadratic differentials in Teichmüller theory and complex harmonic maps
summary: We show that Hitchin-Wolf's harmonic map parametrization of Teichmüller space, the Schwarzian holonomy map, and Uhlenbeck's almost-Fuchsian holonomy map all arise as restrictions of a single locally biholomorphic map into the $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{C})$ character variety. The map admits a right inverse defined on an open subset of quasi-Fuchsian space, encoding harmonic maps together with the Bers embedding.
